narr: A band of showers and thunderstorms developed during the early evening in a moist and unstable environment. The band produced heavy rain across potions of the western Piedmont of central North Carolina during the early evening hours, resulting in isolated flash flooding and isolated wind damage in Randolph County.
ev: Two cars stalled in flood waters in the 6000 block of Fairview Church Road.
Flash flooding was reported near the intersection of Old Glenola Road and Tabacco Road.
lsr: TWO CARS STALLED IN FLOOD WATERS IN THE 6000 BLOCK OF FAIRVIEW CHURCH RD.
IMPASSABLE FLOOD WATERS INUNDATING THE AREA NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF OLD GLENOLA RD AND TABACCO RD.
